# QR Code Generator & Designer

> Free, no-backend QR code generator and designer. Supports URL/text, WiFi,
> vCard, and email content types, with customizable dot styles, corner
> styles, colors/gradients, 11 frame styles, a logo, and a live contrast
> checker for scannability. Runs entirely client-side, no data leaves the
> browser.

## Pages

- [QR Code Generator](https://qrcode.mariaelia.de/): the tool itself. Pick a content type (URL/text, WiFi, vCard, email), customize the design, and export as PNG.
- [Datenschutz](https://qrcode.mariaelia.de/datenschutz/): German-language privacy policy.

## Key facts

- Free to use, no account or sign-up required.
- All QR content is processed locally in the browser; nothing is sent to a server.
- Supported content types: URL/text, WiFi network credentials, vCard contact, email.
- Design options: dot shapes, corner (eye) shapes, solid colors, gradients, 11 frame styles, logo embedding.
- Built by Maria Elia (contact@mariaelia.dev).
